name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (audio/BGM domain). Descriptor accurately reflects behavior: change the active BGM track with a volume fade, with a stop-via-sentinel + fade-out path. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: BGM track manager: change the current background-music track (with fade-in) or stop it (with fade-out), skipping work when the requested track is already the cached current one.
logic_summary: Returns immediately if track_id equals the cached last-set id (data_fd2_audio_bgm_last_set_track_id). Otherwise caches track_id (as a byte). If track_id == 0xFFFFFFFF, issues AIL_set_sequence_volume(handle, 0, 4000) for a 4s fade-out and returns. Otherwise, only when the MDI driver is available (data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_available_flag != 0): stops any existing sequence (if buf ptr non-NULL), loads FDMUS.DAT[track_id] via fd2_load_dat_resource into data_fd2_audio_bgm_sequence_data_buf_ptr, DPMI-locks it (fd2_dpmi_lock_size with data_fd2_resource_last_loaded_resource_size), then AIL_init_sequence + AIL_start_sequence. Initial volume/fade is chosen: BGM disabled -> vol 0 / fade 0 (muted); tracks 0x10 or 0x11 -> vol 0x7F / fade 0 (instant cues); other tracks -> vol 0x7F / fade 2000ms preceded by an anchoring vol 0 / fade 0. Finally AIL_set_sequence_loop_count(handle, loop_count).

params.name: track_id
params.semantics: BGM track id to play (FDMUS.DAT entry index). Stored as a byte in the cache. Magic value 0xFFFFFFFF means 'stop with fade-out'. Tracks 0x10/0x11 are special instant-volume cues. Callers pass per-chapter player/enemy turn BGM ids, 0xFFFFFFFF, or specific track numbers.
params.reason: Accurately names a BGM track identifier; no address residue.

params.name: loop_count
params.semantics: Passed verbatim to AIL_set_sequence_loop_count to set MIDI sequence loop count (callers pass 0 = loop indefinitely per AIL, or 1).
params.reason: Accurately describes the AIL loop-count argument; no address residue.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but markedly terser than the rest of the module: it only said 'Stop (0xFF), change track with fade, or no-op if already playing' and omitted the driver-availability gate, the load/lock/init/start path, the muted / special-cue (0x10,0x11) / regular-fade volume selection, and the loop_count semantics.
notes: src body matches the Ghidra decompilation exactly (logic unchanged; only the comment block was augmented). All referenced globals are byte-identical between Ghidra and src. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the refined understanding, so it was left unchanged. Confirmed param semantics from callers: fd2_run_full_turn_cycle passes per-chapter BGM ids and 0xFFFFFFFF; fd2_play_chapter_clear_fanfare passes (0xFFFFFFFF, 1).
